summary: Verify PR's pr and release profiles shared one measured-durations cache key, and a save keeps only the tasks its plan held, so each pull request erased the slow suites' measurements; a task killed at its shard deadline measured nothing at all. Release (run 40628012072) packed those suites by stale estimates and seven shards hit the 1200s deadline. Each profile now keeps its own key, and a task still running at the deadline is costed at no less than it ran.
